text: Live Railway: /vitafeed override force passed soft thrift while VITAFEED_PAID was off; CDP RISK_KILL_GATE refused every self-call chunk; tg() plain-retried on Too Many Requests and blew up the phone. Fix: thrift paid is hard (force/autofire cannot fake it); tg honors retry_after and cools without retry; sendTx rethrows RISK_KILL_GATE. To seal: set VITAFEED_PAID=yes then confirm|override. Hitch on leftover sells still message-first (untouched).
